title: The 1959 earthquake that woke Yellowstone's geysers #Shorts
description:
August 17, 1959. A magnitude 7.3 earthquake strikes just west of Yellowstone. By the next day, at least 289 springs had erupted as geysers, 160 of them never seen erupting before.

▶ Full documentary (Part 1, What's Really Under Yellowstone): https://youtu.be/-vkXqMrSljM

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History #Volcano
